title: SG-8.2.1 Block blank contribution submit with an inline message
summary: Contribution dialog shows 'Enter an idea first' for empty or whitespace-only text instead of silently returning
description: Context: ContributionSheet.handleSubmit currently executes `if (prompt === '') return;`, so pressing Send with empty or whitespace-only text does nothing and the player gets no feedback. Desired behavior: block the submit and show an inline message 'Enter an idea first'. Expected result: no API call is made and the message is visible and announced. Why: players must understand why nothing was sent.
acceptance_criteria: Given the dialog is open and the textarea is empty, when Send is pressed, then 'Enter an idea first' is shown in an element with role=alert and submitContribution is not called
Given the textarea holds only spaces or newlines, when Send is pressed, then the same message is shown and submitContribution is not called
Given the message is shown, when the player types a character, then the message disappears and a valid idea still submits to the backend

out_of_scope: Max length counter and quota gating
preserve: Trimmed prompt sent on valid submit

technical_constraints: No mock data replacing the real backend client
definition_of_done: Blank and whitespace-only submit shows 'Enter an idea first' and sends nothing
Unit tests cover each acceptance criterion
non_functional: Message is exposed to assistive tech via role=alert and aria-describedby
